documents.title: COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATE FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30Th, 2026.
COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATE FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30Th, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Modis Navnirman reported a 27.92% year-on-year revenue growth for Q1 FY27, reaching INR 58.26 crores, while selling 44,000 square feet of area. The company expanded its redevelopment portfolio to 25 projects, including a new undertaking in Santacruz West, and expects to add two to three more projects during FY27. Management noted that while EBITDA margins were slightly impacted by war-related material and labor cost increases, they anticipate stabilization and healthy project margins of 20% to 30% going forward. Modis Navnirman Limited reported a 27.9% year-on-year increase in revenue to ₹58.26 crore for Q1 FY27, driven by steady construction progress across its residential and commercial projects. The company sold 44,000 square feet during the quarter and secured a new redevelopment project, adding to its pipeline of 10.50 lakh square feet of upcoming developments.

guidance.claim: Management expects to maintain healthy project margins of approximately 20% to 30%.
guidance.quote: But a healthy margins of around 20% to 30% should be expected in every project.

guidance.claim: The company aims to selectively expand its redevelopment portfolio and accelerate project execution.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we remain focused on accelerating project execution, selectively expanding our redevelopment portfolio, maintaining financial discipline, and delivering sustainable value for all stakeholders.

guidance.claim: Management believes the strengthened project pipeline provides enhanced revenue visibility for the future.
guidance.quote: The strengthened project pipeline provides enhanced revenue visibility and positions the Company well for sustained value creation in the years ahead.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver the Rashmi Square project in FY27.
guidance.quote: We will be delivering that project in FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects profit margins to return to previous levels.
guidance.quote: No, no, we'll bounce back to our previous levels.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting a sales rate of 45,000 to 50,000 per square foot for its Khar project.
guidance.quote: 45,000 to 50,000 will be our target range.

guidance.claim: The company targets handing over the Rashmi Signature project in the first quarter of FY27.
guidance.quote: So we arc targeting this project Rashmi Signature to be handed over to the society in the first quarter of <27

demand_outlook.claim: The median age of 29 years in India is expected to drive housing demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Median Age: 29 years driving housing demand

demand_outlook.quote: Because sec India being a safe arca for everyone, the people who had flown out of India, a lot of them have come back or a lot of them are looking to reshuffle and looking for places here.

demand_outlook.quote: So, you're rightly saying that the supply there is a lot supply side is on a higher side and demand is also there, but people have become just choosy now.

demand_outlook.quote: India's real estate market is expectetdo grow approximately 300 billion currently to 5 trillion to 10 trillion by 2047.

capex_expansion.quote: We are going to be around Bombay only as of now.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully secured a new redevelopment project during the first quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: The quarter marked another important milestone for the Company with the successful securing of another new redevelopment project.

capex_expansion.claim: The company recently acquired two new projects, Rashmi Shetal and Rashmi Gold.
capex_expansion.quote: Upcoming projects include Rashmi Shetal and Rashmi Gold which we have recently acquired.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the final stages of a project in Khar and is bidding for projects in Parla and Dadar.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, we have something we are in the final stages ofa project in Khar. We have bid for projects in Parla as well.

capex_expansion.quote: Outside Bombay also we as a company want to make a township project which we arc aiming, but for that we need good location, good land and everything so we are scarching for those opportunities as well

margins_costs.claim: Management expects margins to stabilize and return to historical tracks in the upcoming quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So, now this quarter I think so it will be on track what we've been showing. So, I don't think there will be major differences.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations increased by 27.9% to 58.26 crore in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Modis Navnirman Limited delivered a strong performance in Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations increasing by 27.9% to %58.26 crore

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA grew by 14.2% to 11.65 crore during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: while EBITDA grew by 14.2% to X11.65 crore

margins_costs.claim: The company's gross profit margin for the quarter was 23.62%.
Total raw material expenses for the period ended June 30, 2026, were 44.88 crore.
EBITDA increased by 35% year-on-year to INR 38.46 crores in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA has increased by 35% year-on-year to INR38.46 crores comparetdo INR28.47 crotes in FY25.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax rose by 26% to INR 29.14 crores in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our profit after tax rose by 26% to INR29. 14 crores versus INR23.11 crores in the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Margins experienced temporary moderation due to project mix and construction expenses for larger projects.
margins_costs.quote: While margins saw some moderation due to project mix and execution and ongoing construction expenses associated with larger projects, we believe this is temporary and our long-term margin profile remains healthy.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material costs were impacted by the global war situation, specifically affecting two projects.
margins_costs.quote: So in terms of the war situation has impacted us, but not majorly because currently the execution stage which is at this level, the raw material impact is at a lower level to us.
